evals.prompt: Write a provider for an Anthropic-style API that reads rate limits from response headers, so adaptive-rate-limiter can track them.
evals.expected_output: A class subclassing ProviderInterface implementing all four abstract members.
expectations: Implements all four members: name, discover_limits, parse_rate_limit_response, get_bucket_for_model
parse_rate_limit_response returns a RateLimitInfo and sets is_rate_limited when status_code is 429

evals.prompt: My API has no endpoint to list rate limits up front — limits only appear in response headers. What should discover_limits return in my adaptive-rate-limiter provider?
evals.expected_output: Explains discover_limits should return an empty dict when discovery is unsupported.
expectations: States discover_limits should return an empty dict when discovery is unsupported
States discover_limits should not raise an exception in that case

evals.prompt: How do I implement get_bucket_for_model in my adaptive-rate-limiter provider when some models I don't recognize?
evals.expected_output: Implements get_bucket_for_model and explains returning model_id as a fallback.
expectations: Implements get_bucket_for_model as an async method returning a string
Explains that returning model_id itself is a safe fallback for unknown models
